fact_text: Budget tax measures that the business community criticised took effect from 1 July 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said it is unclear whether the 50% disallowance covers only costs of executing the sale or the entire cost, which causes confusion and frustration.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert argued that registered, documented sellers face extra pressure under the cash rule, because buyers may switch to suppliers who help them avoid banking channels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Buying from a seller without an NTN means the buyer has 10% of that purchase disallowed for tax purposes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Purchases from farmers are exempt from the NTN requirement, so the 10% purchase disallowance does not apply to farm produce bought from them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert noted that the cash and NTN purchase rules affect taxpayers only at assessment, after they file returns, when the FBR enforces them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert questioned whether the FBR's machinery is strong enough to enforce the new purchase and invoice provisions at the assessment stage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Under the Finance Act, online marketplaces and courier services may not let a person without an NTN or sales tax registration use their platform.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The marketplace and courier responsibility applies to both sales tax and income tax, not only to sales tax.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said checking registration is a task of the tax administration, and questioned why it was placed on marketplaces and couriers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Section 37AB of the Sales Tax Act gives officers arrest powers where tax fraud occurs, a taxpayer does not attend hearings after notice, or the person may abscond.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The 37AB process has an officer investigation step and an investigation committee; above a defined limit a different committee holds the arrest powers, with special judges involved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the 37AB arrest powers apply only if tax fraud is properly defined and met, and are not applicable otherwise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Digital invoicing requires each invoice to carry a QR code and a unique invoice number, with the seller's system linked to the FBR's so that invoices are reported in real time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Digital invoicing as described applies to both corporate and non-corporate customers, so the compliance load falls on all taxpayers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Digital invoicing is meant to stop sales tax evasion and fake or flying invoices, which the tax expert considered a sound measure in principle.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the volume of taxpayers is very large while the staff to enforce digital invoicing is small, so implementation will take time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the new compliance work carries an incremental cost that taxpayers bear themselves, and that concessions should offset it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert recalled that when an earlier electronic system was introduced, businesses were given tax advantages, and said similar concessions were needed now.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert recommended an implementation period of three to six months rather than a one-month extension.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the companies appointed to run the FBR system were not fully prepared, and that the FBR was not accommodating taxpayers in its implementation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert suggested starting enforcement in the sectors with the highest smuggling and transparency risk, rather than applying measures everywhere at once.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Transporters planned to join a business community strike on 19 July 2025 over concerns about the government's cargo tracking plan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: A planned cargo tracking system would give cargo a digital passport, so that goods entering and leaving through ports can be traced.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the cargo tracking measure is right in substance and timing, but has no system or guidelines in place yet, and transporters need training.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the measures are correct in direction but were not planned appropriately, with rushed timing and too little implementation time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said the budget lacks measures for equitable distribution of wealth between rich and poor, which taxation should aim for.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said agriculture, real estate and retail look fine in the numbers, but ground realities show a struggle for businesses in those sectors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The cash rule applies to goods or services a seller supplies, and the government's stated stance is that buyers should pay through banking or digital channels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The government's stated aim for these measures is to broaden the tax base through documentation of businesses, as the tax expert described it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The tax expert said registered taxpayers were made to bear the penalty instead of being supported, which he called a contradiction in the design of the measures.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s New Tax Measures: Reform or Economic Chaos? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)
